game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Coastal Port – Shipyard Slip, a shipyard building boats: the fisher must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Gatekeeper If: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors.
theme: Coastal Port – Shipyard Slip: a shipyard building boats
core_gameplay_loop: In Shipyard Slip, repeat each round: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the gate_integrity value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about gate_integrity to power up the fisher and open the dock crane.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Gatekeeper If
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Gatekeeper If' (Week 3 slot 1), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Shipyard Slip'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gate_integrity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Shipyard Slip.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
